checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Three separate finished assets delivered: 4:5 poster, 9:16 story, 9:16 reel
must.why: The poster is 512x640 (4:5). The story is 352x640 (9:16). The reel frames are 480x854 (9:16).

must.item: All three use warm lantern imagery and a coordinated midnight-blue-and-gold design
must.why: Both images and the reel footage show glowing lanterns on a midnight-blue night sky. The title is gold. The text card is not visible in the frames I have.

must.item: Each asset includes the exact event name, date, time, venue and free-entry wording
must.why: Both images show all five lines correctly. The reel frames only cover the first 5 s, so the text card is not visible.

must.item: Reel runs 10 seconds with visible motion
must.why: The 5 s lantern clip shows a clear camera move, with lanterns getting closer between frames. The full 10 s length is not shown, and the 15 s audio file does not match 10 s.

must.item: Text legible and unclipped in both images; reel holds details long enough to read
must.why: Both images have clear, unclipped text. The reel card's 5 s hold cannot be seen from the frames provided.

faults.what: The reel's text card (5–10 s) is not in the frames I was given, so the reel text could not be checked.
The audio file is 15 s but the reel is 10 s, so it must be trimmed or may not fit.
The images are low resolution (640 px). This is a free-plan limit, and the agent said so.
The lantern footage has some soft AI-looking detail, such as a bulb hanging in the sky and slightly smeared lanterns.
The poster and story have a large empty area of dark sky. The text sits top-left and is small relative to the canvas.

summary: The poster and story image are matching, correctly spelled lantern designs in midnight blue and gold. The reel's lantern footage moves well, but the text card was not visible to check, and the audio length (15 s) doesn't match the 10 s reel.
